summary: NuRAN Wireless filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching an October 16, 2026 press release announcing that CEO Francis Létourneau will attend the Africa Tech Festival in Cape Town on November 17–19, 2026, for meetings with mobile network operators, government representatives and potential infrastructure partners. The release cites activation of 29 additional towers in October, over 5,000 towers under contract with Orange and MTN across eight countries, and a financing-dependent target of 1,650 operating sites by mid-2028. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock is disclosed; this is a routine operational and investor-relations update, not a special situation.
